Provides low-level access to 'GDAL' functionality. 'GDAL'
is the 'Geospatial Data Abstraction Library' a translator for
raster and vector geospatial data formats that presents a
single raster abstract data model and single vector abstract
data model to the calling application for all supported formats
<https://gdal.org/>. This package is focussed on providing
exactly and only what GDAL does, to enable developing further
tools.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.16.0"

package:
  name: r-vapour
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url:
    - ${{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/vapour_${{ version }}.tar.gz
    - ${{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/vapour/vapour_${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 865927d1036ebd948e7897b4da83af89b036fde87cd6857e84001345bdc1590f
  patches:
    # Link configure's GDAL/PROJ test programs with LDFLAGS so they get the
    # $PREFIX/lib rpath and can run; remove once fixed upstream.
    - pass-ldflags-to-configure-test-links.patch
    # conda-forge's Windows gdal.pc is MSVC-style and breaks R's link command,
    # so link the GDAL and PROJ import libraries directly (as r-sf does).
    - link-conda-forge-gdal-proj-on-windows.patch
    # Drop a global `using namespace std;` that makes `list` ambiguous with
    # cpp11::list under the MSVC STL; remove once fixed upstream.
    - drop-using-namespace-std.patch
    - if: win
      then:
        # The r_clang wrapper drops R's generated tmp.def export list, so
        # export the package init function explicitly (as r-sf does).
        - export-r-init-vapour-on-windows.patch

build:
  number: 1
  script:
    - if: win
      then: R CMD INSTALL --build . %R_ARGS%
      else: R CMD INSTALL --build . ${R_ARGS}
  dynamic_linking:
    rpaths:
      - lib/R/lib/
      - lib/

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-r-base ${{ r_base }}.*
    # See variants.yaml
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - if: win
      then:
        - m2-filesystem
        # MSYS2 make strips the shell quoting R passes in SHLIB_LD, which native
        # make does not.
        - m2-make
        - m2-sed
        - m2-coreutils
        - m2-zip
      else:
        - make
        # Only configure (unix) uses pkg-config, to find PROJ.
        - pkgconf
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - libgdal-core
    - proj
    - r-base
    - r-cpp11
    - r-jsonlite
    - r-nanoarrow
    - r-stringr
    - r-wk
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-jsonlite
    - r-nanoarrow
    - r-stringr
    - r-wk

tests:
  - r:
      libraries:
        - vapour
  - files:
      source:
        - tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - r-testthat
    script:
      - Rscript -e "testthat::test_file('tests/testthat.R', stop_on_failure=TRUE)"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/hypertidy/vapour
  summary: Access to the 'Geospatial Data Abstraction Library' ('GDAL')
  description: |-
    Provides low-level access to 'GDAL' functionality. 'GDAL'
    is the 'Geospatial Data Abstraction Library' a translator for
    raster and vector geospatial data formats that presents a
    single raster abstract data model and single vector abstract
    data model to the calling application for all supported formats
    <https://gdal.org/>. This package is focussed on providing
    exactly and only what GDAL does, to enable developing further
    tools.
  license: GPL-3.0-only
  license_file:
    - ${{ PREFIX }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-3
  repository: https://github.com/hypertidy/vapour
  documentation: https://hypertidy.github.io/vapour/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
    - mdsumner
